//go:build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pg "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/generatedcourse"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrevision"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root starts this opt-in harness serially against an owned migrated database.
// All Course persistence, hierarchy creation and revision receipts are real.
// NATS publishing is deliberately absent; no lifecycle-event proof is claimed.
func TestT08GeneratedCourseHTTPProvider(t *testing.T) {
	dsn, token := os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_TEST_DATABASE_URL"), os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_TOKEN")
	readyFile, stopFile := os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T08_COURSE_STOP_FILE")
	if dsn == "" || token == "" || readyFile == "" || stopFile == "" {
		t.Skip("owned T08 Course provider fixture is not configured")
	}
	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid owned T08 Course database configuration")
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(config.ConnConfig.Database, "remediation_t08_") || !strings.HasSuffix(config.ConnConfig.Database, "_test") {
		t.Fatal("T08 Course database must be an owned remediation_t08_*_test database")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Migrations and reference seeding are separate root-owned operations.
	var structureCount int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM code_structure_type WHERE code='QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC'`).Scan(&structureCount); err != nil || structureCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: owned Course QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC reference missing: count=%d err=%v", structureCount, err)
	}
	lessons := pg.LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	translations := pg.LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	tasks := pg.TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	examples := pg.LessonExampleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	revisions := lessonrevision.Definitions{
		Revisions: pg.LessonRevisionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Lessons: lessons, Translations: translations,
		Tasks: tasks, Tests: pg.TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Files: pg.TaskFileStorageRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Examples: examples, Tx: pg.LessonRevisionTxPG{Pool: pool},
	}
	ensure := generatedcourse.Ensure{
		Revisions: revisions, Generated: pg.GeneratedCourseRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Courses: pg.CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseI18n: pg.CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Modules: pg.ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleI18n: pg.ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseModules: pg.CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Sections: pg.SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, SectionI18n: pg.SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleSections: pg.ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: translations, SectionLessons: pg.SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Examples: examples, Tasks: tasks, TaskI18n: pg.TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskTargets: pg.TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		StructureTypes: pg.CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool}, I18n: pg.I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Tx: pg.TxManagerPG{Pool: pool},
		IDs: t08CourseIDs{}, Clock: t08CourseClock{},
	}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(nil, nil, nil, &privatehandlers.GeneratedCourseHandler{Ensure: ensure}, "", token, ""))
	server := httptest.NewServer(router)
	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
	ready, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"base_url":       server.URL,
		"classification": "actual registered Course private HTTP + PostgreSQL + lesson revision receipts; no NATS/Start/validators",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(readyFile, ready, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("T08 owned actual Course provider ready; credentials excluded")
	t08WaitCourseStop(t, stopFile)
	var courses, requests, lessonsCount, revisionsCount, revisionReceipts int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM generated_course), (SELECT count(*) FROM generated_course_request), (SELECT count(*) FROM generated_lesson), (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_revision), (SELECT count(*) FROM generated_course_revision_receipt)`).Scan(&courses, &requests, &lessonsCount, &revisionsCount, &revisionReceipts); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("owned actual Course SQL readback: courses=%d requests=%d generatedLessons=%d lessonRevisions=%d revisionReceipts=%d", courses, requests, lessonsCount, revisionsCount, revisionReceipts)
	rows, err := pool.Query(ctx, `SELECT r.idempotency_key::text,r.course_id::text,g.lesson_id::text,COALESCE(b.value->>'lesson_revision_id','')
FROM generated_course_request r JOIN generated_lesson g ON g.course_id=r.course_id
LEFT JOIN generated_course_revision_receipt rev ON rev.idempotency_key=r.idempotency_key
LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(rev.lessons) b(value) ON b.value->>'lesson_id'=g.lesson_id::text
ORDER BY r.idempotency_key,g.lesson_id`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	for rows.Next() {
		var requestID, courseID, lessonID, revisionID string
		if err := rows.Scan(&requestID, &courseID, &lessonID, &revisionID); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("owned actual Course binding: request=%s course=%s lesson=%s revision=%s", requestID, courseID, lessonID, revisionID)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

type t08CourseIDs struct{}

func (t08CourseIDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type t08CourseClock struct{}

func (t08CourseClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }

func t08WaitCourseStop(t *testing.T, stopFile string) {
	t.Helper()
	timer := time.NewTimer(15 * time.Minute)
	defer timer.Stop()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(200 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(stopFile); err == nil {
			return
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Fatal("T08 Course provider timed out awaiting root stop file")
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
